layman_headline: Both current positions are slightly green — patience is the play while the market finds direction.
layman_explanation: We're holding two positions: Solana (up 1%) and Chainlink (up 1.4%). The overall crypto market is still in a 'Fear' zone but sentiment is improving from last week. There are no compelling new entry opportunities right now — the swing candidates are either wildly overbought (Bitway at RSI 93), stablecoins with no upside, or lacking sufficient technical data to build conviction. Bitcoin is holding $64K but dominance remains high at 56.5%, which means altcoins are still struggling relative to BTC.
layman_action: Continue holding SOL and LINK with existing stop-losses in place. No new trades today — the candidate list is weak. Wait for a clearer setup with proper technical signals before deploying more capital.
expert_reasoning: The swing candidate list is extremely poor this cycle. BTW is at RSI 92.7 with a 194% 7-day move — a textbook correction setup, not a buy. VELVET had a 31.7% daily pump but lacks volume data, SMA history, and MACD confirmation. FDUSD, XAUT, PAXG, and USDG are stablecoins/gold-backed tokens with no swing potential. MON lacks any technical indicators. SOL and LINK in our portfolio are both in early profitable territory with clear stop-losses and targets. Given the Fear & Greed at 46 (improving trend from 34.9 weekly average), the market could be building toward a better entry window in coming days. High BTC dominance at 56.5% continues to suppress alt performance, making new alt entries risky without strong catalysts.
